svg.title: 01 SHADOW physical placement proof — placeholder only, not vendor artwork

g.text: A4 PRINT: 100% / ACTUAL SIZE. Disable Fit to page.
Measure the 100 mm calibration bar with a ruler before use.
100 mm reference: must measure 100 mm physically.
82 mm full image envelope; NOT vendor printable zone.
Dotted box = alpha extent; no proprietary art included.
CUT OUT THE 82 mm BOX ONLY AFTER CALIBRATION PASSES.
Place paper on real blank garment at left chest; record:
HPS-to-art-top: ______ mm Flat garment: YES / NO
Actual flat chest: ______ mm Position: APPROVE / REJECT
CF = center front; HPS = high point shoulder.
Paper test only; not supplier-approved print method or placement.
DO NOT SEND AS FINAL PRINT ARTWORK.
No logo, third-party upload, purchase or seller approval.
If calibration differs from 100 mm, reprint at 100%.
